prompt: Unseen case: six replicas, maxUnavailable one, PDB minAvailable five, required hostname anti-affinity, five eligible nodes, one drain, a new revision and HPA desired ten. Produce evidence, feasibility math, containment, recovery and verification without lesson answers.
deliverables: Exact cluster, context, namespace, controller UID, ReplicaSet revisions and Pod UIDs.
Feasible-node calculation across requests, affinity, taints, topology, quota and drain state.
Separation of Deployment availability controls from eviction admission through the PDB.
Explanation of HPA desired replicas versus schedulable and Ready capacity.
Impact statement, bounded containment and owner-level recovery.
Revision-aware endpoints and normal user-operation verification.
One resilience/cost trade-off and one preventive design correction.
Exact namespace, credential and disposable-cluster cleanup plus delayed changed-case transfer.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies object identities, constraints and timing not derived from LES-0042.
Learner uses only a namespace-scoped identity; reviewer owns cluster lifecycle and drain authority.
No external registry, cloud, hostPath, privileged workload, cluster-scoped mutation or unbounded load.
Raw evidence is tied to context, version, namespace, UID, revision and UTC time.
One failed hypothesis is preserved and corrected from evidence.
Reviewer observes recovery, exact cleanup and a delayed case with different constraints.
